# The New Republic

> > The New Republic is a progressive American magazine covering politics, policy, culture, and breaking news with a focus on the Trump administration and contemporary political issues.

Founded as a journal of opinion and analysis, The New Republic provides in-depth political commentary, investigative journalism, and cultural criticism. The publication also offers curated reader experiences including cultural travel programs.

## Key Topics

- Trump administration
- Breaking political news
- Government investigations
- National security
- Iran conflict
- Progressive politics
- Media coverage analysis
- Cultural commentary
- Policy analysis
- Cuban culture and history
- Political journalism
- Contemporary American politics
